name: Alps
hint: Major mountain range in central Europe forming a natural barrier between north and south, home to Mont Blanc

name: Himalayas
hint: World's highest mountain range, containing all peaks over 8,000 m including Mount Everest

name: Andes
hint: World's longest continental mountain range, running along the entire western coast of South America

name: Pyrenees
hint: Mountain range forming a natural border between France and Spain on the Iberian Peninsula

name: Caucasus
hint: Mountain range stretching between the Black Sea and the Caspian Sea, with Mount Elbrus as its highest peak

name: Carpathians
hint: Arc-shaped mountain range in Central and Eastern Europe forming a natural boundary across multiple countries

name: Atlas
hint: Mountain range running through northwestern Africa, separating the Sahara Desert from the Mediterranean coast

name: Rockies
hint: Major mountain range in western North America stretching from Canada southward into the United States

name: Urals
hint: Mountain range running north-south through Russia, traditionally marking the boundary between Europe and Asia

name: Scandinavian Mountains
hint: Mountain range forming the spine of the Scandinavian Peninsula, creating Norway's dramatic fjords on its western side

name: Zagros
hint: Extensive mountain range in the Middle East forming the geological border between the Arabian and Eurasian plates

name: Hindu Kush
hint: Mountain range forming the western extension of the Himalayas, dividing Central and South Asia

name: Tian Shan
hint: Vast Central Asian mountain system extending from western China through multiple countries, with peaks over 7,000 m

name: Altai
hint: Mountain range at the convergence of four countries in the heart of Eurasia, source of the Irtysh and Ob rivers

name: Drakensberg
hint: Great escarpment and mountain range forming a dramatic wall along the eastern edge of the southern African plateau

name: Rwenzori
hint: Equatorial mountain range on the Uganda-DRC border, known as the 'Mountains of the Moon' with glaciers at the equator
